crossRefs.note: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be…
because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all…
because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other…
those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that…
You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

translations.web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

translations.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
